notes.title: Gloomy Eyes glows at Gamescom 2025
notes.content: [p]Dear wanderers,[/p][p][/p][p]Tales of an awaited event,[/p][p]Have been rumored.[/p][p]In far foreign lands, [/p][p]Something ascends.[/p][p][/p][p]From [b]August 20th to 24th,[/b] [/p][p][b]Gamescom [/b]moves forth,[/p][p]And [b]Gloomy Eyes demo[/b] comes along,[/p][p]To the eerie lands of Köln.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729358/d7e44d49fa58d27d875544747e672425213eb6b5.png"][/img][/p][p]So wanderers, [/p][p][/p][p]If you are lost in the dark,[/p][p]Look for the firefly glow of[b] ARTE’s stand[/b] light,[/p][p]To guide your journey, so tenebrous,[/p][p]Through the ethereal[b] Indie Arena Booth[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2667950/Gloomy_Eyes/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Gloomy Eyes will release September 12th on PC/Mac and consoles!
notes.content:
[p]Wanderer, I wish you a good day.
But what does “day” mean, anyway?
Where I dwell, no light breaks the night,
For the Sun has vanished from sight.[/p][p]Yet deep within the shadow’s seam,
A distant spark begins to gleam.
A boy, eyes shining through the dark,
A girl, chasing each glowing spark.[/p][p]They must recall, through ash and ember,
[b]Their quest begins: the 12th of September.[/b]
On Xbox, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PC and Mac,
They’ll brave the dark to bring the Sun back.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="rUYXQhoZMoU;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Gloomy Eyes is coming to PC and consoles — A Word from the Gravekeeper 🌕🌕
notes.content:
[h3]Even though the sun left, there’s still light in the darkness…[/h3][p]
[/p][p]Hello, Wanderer.[/p][p]It’s not every day the dead have news worth sharing.[/p][p]But today… oh, today is quite the exception.[/p][p][/p][p]Through shadows and soil, with the help of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/untoldtales"]Untold Tales[/url][/p][p]Gloomy Eyes will rise to PC and consoles.[/p][p]
[/p][p]It’s a tale I’ve long watched from my perch beneath the stones. [/p][p]A boy with no heartbeat.[/p][p]A girl who walks toward the dark.[/p][p]And a sun that forgot how to shine.[/p][p]
[/p][p]The living will see what lies beneath.[/p][p]And the world will finally hear our side of the tale.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Here's a first glimpse of what's to come. Watch closely.[/p][p]Exclusively revealed by [b]IGN[/b]:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="in2LBOovYXc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]And remember… [/p][p]A single firefly’s glow can spark a thousand dreams.[/p][p]Be that spark – add Gloomy Eyes to your wishlist.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2667950/Gloomy_Eyes/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][b]~ The Gravekeeper[/b][/p][p][i]Speaker for the silent.
[/i][/p]

notes.title: Gloomy Eyes Demo Emerges – The Gravekeeper’s Invitation ✉️
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, wanderer.[/p][p]I don’t write often, but sometimes even the dead must reach out.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Something stirs beneath the soil.[/p][p]Someone waits for you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]From [b]June 9 to 16,[/b] a door creaks open.[/p][p]The [b]Gloomy Eyes Demo[/b] rises with Steam Next Fest.[/p][p]A zombie boy and a curious girl are on the verge of something vast. 
And they can’t do it alone.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]This isn’t the whole story. Not yet.[/p][p]But it’s enough to feel the chill of forgotten places...[/p][p]To walk where the living dare not linger...[/p][p]To meet a boy who refuses to stay buried.
[/p][p][/p][p]Few pass this way anymore.[/p][p]But should you step through—[/p][p]Know that I’ll be watching.[/p][p]
[b]The gate stands open:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2667950/Gloomy_Eyes/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]And if, after all this,[/p][p]Something inside you flickers—[/p][p]Leave a sign.[/p][p][b]A wishlist will do.[/b]
[/p][p][/p][p]~ [b]The Gravekeeper[/b][/p][p][i]Watcher of all that should have stayed beneath the earth[/i][/p][p]
[/p]
